offerings.heading: Cabinets, tops, <mark>and the fab floor.</mark>
items: Cabinetry for kitchens and baths, specified in the showroom before anyone cuts a box.
Countertops selected and templated so the top matches the run, not a leftover slab photo.
Fabrication in house, which is why the remodel doesn't die between a cabinet shop and a stone yard.
Kitchen and bath remodeling in West Chester

story.heading: A West Chester shop that still fabricates
paragraphs: MacLaren runs kitchen and bath remodels from a showroom that also fabricates. Cabinets and countertops aren't two separate errands.
Weekday hours are 8:30 to 4:30. The official site is the door. Cabinets and countertops have their own pages.
Hours: Monday-Friday 8:30 AM-4:30 PM. Confirm details on the official site before you drive.

experience.heading: How a remodel is supposed to start.
items: Meet in the showroom. Scope first, then a preliminary design and a real number.
You pick cabinets and the countertop as one sequence, not two vendors.
Install follows fabrication. Follow-up is part of the same job.

feature.heading: Fabrication keeps the remodel on one floor
feature.text: A kitchen dies in the handoff between cabinetry and stone. MacLaren keeps both in the same shop, then installs what they built. Cabinetry for kitchens and baths, specified in the showroom before anyone cuts a box.
